newer_changes_search: Web search (PIB, DFS, press) for 2025-2026 PMSBY changes: last premium revision 1 June 2022 (Rs 12 to Rs 20); PIB material of May 2025 still lists Rs 20 / Rs 2 lakh. No 2026 notification of a premium or cover change found.

findings.note: Matches the DFS page. Under the scheme rules the Rs 1 lakh is for permanent partial disability (e.g. loss of one eye/limb); 'partial disability' alone may make people expect payment for temporary injuries. The cited page itself only says 'partial disability'.
findings.suggestion: Optional: say 'permanent partial disability' if a source (PMSBY rules on jansuraksha.gov.in) is added.

findings.note: Age 18-70 inclusive (>=18, <=70) matches 'age group of 18 to 70 years'; guidance fits a portal source; fixtures cover 17/18/70/71 and the straddling band. Bank account and consent have no field and are covered by documents and how_to_apply.
